user.title: Location
user.description: Pick on the map the point you want the forecast for. By default it is your Home Assistant home.

data_description.location: Point on the map. By default, your Home Assistant home.

confirm.title: Confirm location
confirm.description: Your point is in **{concello}**. Check the municipality and the station, and change them if needed.{station_note}

data.station_weather: Use the station for current weather
data.air_station_use: Use the station for the current air quality

data_description.concello_id: The forecast and weather warnings are for this municipality.
data_description.station_id: Optional. Adds measured, real-time data. Each one shows whether it lacks wind or pressure, or is not sending data now. Leave it empty if you don't want to use one.
data_description.station_weather: Temperature, humidity, pressure and wind of the weather entity, measured at the station. Untick it if the station doesn't represent your point well (altitude, coast): the station sensors stay, but the weather entity uses the forecast.
data_description.camera_id: Optional. Picture from a MeteoGalicia camera, refreshed about every 5 minutes. If the station has a camera, it's already selected.
data_description.air_station_id: Optional. Measures air quality every hour (PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, ozone…). Each one shows its distance and type: traffic and industrial stations measure the street or the plant, not the neighbourhood. Without a station, air quality comes from the MeteoGalicia model at your point.
data_description.air_station_use: The current air quality, measured at the station. Untick it if it does not represent your point well: its sensors stay, but the level will come from the model.

reconfigure.title: MeteoSIX API key
reconfigure.description: With a MeteoSIX API key, the hourly forecast also includes rain, wind, humidity and pressure. It is free: request one from MeteoGalicia at {url}. Leave the field empty to use MeteoGal without a key.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Leave it empty to remove it.

reauth_confirm.title: The MeteoSIX API key no longer works
reauth_confirm.description: MeteoSIX does not accept the saved key. Enter a new one or leave the field empty to keep going without a key. You can request another one from MeteoGalicia at {url}.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Leave it empty to remove it.

error.outside_galicia: That point is outside Galicia. MeteoGalicia only has data for Galicia: pick another point.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to MeteoGalicia. Try again in a few minutes.
error.invalid_api_key: MeteoSIX does not accept this key. Check that you copied all of it.
error.cannot_connect_meteosix: Could not connect to MeteoSIX to check the key. Try again in a few minutes.

abort.single_instance_allowed: MeteoGal is already set up. To add another location, use “Add location” in the integration.
abort.already_configured: That location is already set up.

get_warnings.name: Get warnings
get_warnings.description: Returns all weather warnings for the location, active and upcoming, with their type, level, start and end.

get_air_quality.name: Get air quality
get_air_quality.description: Returns the air quality for the location: now, each hour forecast by the MeteoGalicia model and each day forecast for the municipality.

station_stale.title: The station for {location} is not sending data

confirm.title: Choose another station
confirm.description:
The station {station}, for the location **{location}**, has not sent data since {since}. Its sensors stay «Unknown» and the current weather comes from the forecast.

Choose another station, or leave the field empty to use none. You can ignore this notice if you prefer to wait for it to come back: it goes away by itself when the station sends data again.

data_description.station_id: From nearest to farthest. Each one shows whether it lacks wind or pressure, or is not sending data now.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to MeteoGalicia to get the list of stations. Try again in a few minutes.
